metrics.name: googleAnalytics4.activeUsers
metrics.label: Active users
metrics.description: Active users. Users who had an engaged session, or when Analytics collected first_visit or engagement_time from a page.

metrics.name: googleAnalytics4.totalUsers
metrics.label: Total users
metrics.description: Users who logged at least one event, new or returning.

metrics.name: googleAnalytics4.newUsers
metrics.label: New users
metrics.description: Users who interacted with your site or app for the first time.

metrics.name: googleAnalytics4.sessions
metrics.label: Sessions
metrics.description: Periods when users are actively engaged with your site or app.

metrics.name: googleAnalytics4.sessionsPerUser
metrics.label: Sessions per user
metrics.description: Average number of sessions per user.

metrics.name: googleAnalytics4.engagedSessions
metrics.label: Engaged sessions
metrics.description: Sessions that lasted longer than 10 seconds, had a conversion event, or had at least 2 page views.

metrics.name: googleAnalytics4.screenPageViews
metrics.label: Page views
metrics.description: Total count of screen or page views recorded.

metrics.name: googleAnalytics4.eventCount
metrics.label: Events
metrics.description: Count of event instances recorded.

metrics.name: googleAnalytics4.eventValue
metrics.label: Event value
metrics.description: Total monetary value attributed to user interactions with your site or app.

metrics.name: googleAnalytics4.itemViews
metrics.label: Item views
metrics.description: Total count of item views recorded.

metrics.name: googleAnalytics4.addToCarts
metrics.label: Add-to-carts
metrics.description: Number of times users added items to their shopping cart.

metrics.name: googleAnalytics4.itemsPurchased
metrics.label: Items purchased
metrics.description: Number of items purchased by users.

metrics.name: googleAnalytics4.purchaseRevenue
metrics.label: Purchase revenue
metrics.description: Total revenue generated from purchases, in your account currency.

metrics.name: googleAnalytics4.totalRevenue
metrics.label: Total revenue
metrics.description: Total revenue across all transaction types recorded, in your account currency.

metrics.name: googleAnalytics4.transactionsPerPurchaser
metrics.label: Transactions per purchaser
metrics.description: Average number of transactions per user who made a purchase.

metrics.name: googleAnalytics4.averagePurchaseRevenue
metrics.label: Avg. purchase revenue
metrics.description: Average revenue generated per purchase transaction.

metrics.name: googleAnalytics4.purchaserRate
metrics.label: Purchaser rate
metrics.description: Percentage of active users who made a purchase: purchasers ÷ active users.

metrics.name: googleAnalytics4.conversions
metrics.label: Conversions
metrics.description: Number of completed conversion actions you are measuring (e.g. purchases, sign-ups, leads).

metrics.name: googleAnalytics4.engagementRate
metrics.label: Engagement rate
metrics.description: Percentage of sessions that were engaged (lasted 10+ seconds, had a conversion, or had 2+ page views): engaged sessions ÷ total sessions.

metrics.name: googleAnalytics4.userEngagementDuration
metrics.label: User engagement duration
metrics.description: Total time users spent engaged with your site or app, in seconds.

metrics.name: googleAnalytics4.averageSessionDuration
metrics.label: Avg. session duration
metrics.description: Average duration of each session in seconds.

metrics.name: googleAnalytics4.bounceRate
metrics.label: Bounce rate
metrics.description: Percentage of sessions that were not engaged sessions: non-engaged sessions ÷ total sessions.

metrics.name: googleAnalytics4.totalAdCost
metrics.label: Total ad cost
metrics.description: Total amount spent on linked ads (e.g. Google Ads), in your account currency.

metrics.name: googleAnalytics4.advertiserAdClicks
metrics.label: Ad clicks
metrics.description: Number of clicks on your ads.

metrics.name: googleAnalytics4.advertiserAdImpressions
metrics.label: Ad impressions
metrics.description: Number of times your ads were displayed to users.

metrics.name: googleAnalytics4.advertiserAdCostPerClick
metrics.label: Ad CPC
metrics.description: Average cost per click on your ads, calculated as total ad cost divided by clicks.

metrics.name: googleAnalytics4.returnOnAdSpend
metrics.label: ROAS
metrics.description: Return on ad spend: attributed revenue divided by ad cost.

metrics.name: googleAnalytics4.conversionRate
metrics.label: Conversion rate
metrics.description: Percentage of sessions that resulted in a conversion: conversions ÷ sessions.

metrics.name: googleAnalytics4.advertiserAdCtr
metrics.label: Ad CTR
metrics.description: Click-through rate for linked ads: ad clicks ÷ ad impressions.

metrics.name: googleAnalytics4.adCostPerConversion
metrics.label: Cost per conversion
metrics.description: Average ad spend per conversion: total ad cost ÷ conversions.

dimensions.name: googleAnalytics4.date
dimensions.label: Date
dimensions.description: Calendar date for the report row.

dimensions.name: googleAnalytics4.isoYearIsoWeek
dimensions.label: ISO year + week
dimensions.description: ISO year and week number for the report row (e.g. 202305 = week 5 of 2023).

dimensions.name: googleAnalytics4.year
dimensions.label: Year
dimensions.description: Year of the report row. Used when reporting is grouped by calendar year.

dimensions.name: googleAnalytics4.yearMonth
dimensions.label: Year + month
dimensions.description: Year and month of the report row (YYYYMM).

dimensions.name: googleAnalytics4.month
dimensions.label: Month
dimensions.description: Month of the report row (01–12).

dimensions.name: googleAnalytics4.week
dimensions.label: Week
dimensions.description: Week of the year (01–53).

dimensions.name: googleAnalytics4.dateHour
dimensions.label: Date + hour
dimensions.description: Date and hour. Combined date and hour (YYYYMMDDHH).

dimensions.name: googleAnalytics4.dateHourMinute
dimensions.label: Date + hour + minute
dimensions.description: Date, hour, and minute of the report row (YYYYMMDDHHmm).

dimensions.name: googleAnalytics4.country
dimensions.label: Country
dimensions.description: Country associated with user activity.

dimensions.name: googleAnalytics4.region
dimensions.label: Region
dimensions.description: Geographic region for user activity.

dimensions.name: googleAnalytics4.city
dimensions.label: City
dimensions.description: City associated with user activity.

dimensions.name: googleAnalytics4.deviceCategory
dimensions.label: Device category
dimensions.description: Desktop, mobile, or tablet.

dimensions.name: googleAnalytics4.platform
dimensions.label: Platform
dimensions.description: Platform used for the session (Web, iOS, Android).

dimensions.name: googleAnalytics4.platformDeviceCategory
dimensions.label: Platform + device
dimensions.description: Platform and device category combined (e.g. web / mobile, iOS / tablet).

dimensions.name: googleAnalytics4.browser
dimensions.label: Browser
dimensions.description: Web browser used for the session.

dimensions.name: googleAnalytics4.operatingSystem
dimensions.label: Operating system
dimensions.description: Operating system of the device used in the session (e.g. Windows, iOS, Android).

dimensions.name: googleAnalytics4.sessionSource
dimensions.label: Session source
dimensions.description: Traffic source that brought the session (e.g. google, direct, newsletter).

dimensions.name: googleAnalytics4.sessionMedium
dimensions.label: Session medium
dimensions.description: Traffic medium for the session (e.g. cpc, organic, email).

dimensions.name: googleAnalytics4.sessionCampaignName
dimensions.label: Session campaign
dimensions.description: Campaign name that brought the session.

dimensions.name: googleAnalytics4.sessionDefaultChannelGroup
dimensions.label: Default channel group
dimensions.description: Marketing channel group for the session (e.g. Paid Search, Organic).

dimensions.name: googleAnalytics4.firstUserSource
dimensions.label: First user source
dimensions.description: Traffic source that first acquired the user (e.g. google, direct).

dimensions.name: googleAnalytics4.firstUserMedium
dimensions.label: First user medium
dimensions.description: Traffic medium through which the user was first acquired (e.g. cpc, organic).

dimensions.name: googleAnalytics4.currencyCode
dimensions.label: Currency code
dimensions.description: Currency code for the transaction data.

dimensions.name: googleAnalytics4.eventName
dimensions.label: Event name
dimensions.description: Name of the collected event.

dimensions.name: googleAnalytics4.pagePath
dimensions.label: Page path
dimensions.description: Path portion of the page URL.

dimensions.name: googleAnalytics4.pageTitle
dimensions.label: Page title
dimensions.description: HTML document title of the page as collected by Google Analytics.

dimensions.name: googleAnalytics4.landingPage
dimensions.label: Landing page
dimensions.description: Page path where the session began.

dimensions.name: googleAnalytics4.unifiedPagePathScreen
dimensions.label: Page path / screen name
dimensions.description: Unified path for both web pages and app screens.
